requirements.title: Server-derived society and role scope on every object, query, cache, search and file
Money is integer paise; posted journals balance, are immutable and retry-safe
Local deterministic policy decides entry; models never actuate; no auto-allow on timeout
Four independent relationships: ownership, occupancy, billing liability, statutory vote
Advertising, commercial push, data resale and unrelated profiling are prohibited
AI only proposes; deterministic permission and approval services execute
Statuses from submitted through settled are kept distinct and shown truthfully
Essential services are never restricted because of debt
Self-service export and migration manifest for every society
Interest caps, quorum, notice, weights, tax and retention come from approved packs
Guards and staff finish every core flow in-language, supported by icons and audio
Every SLO is instrumented and reported; claims come only from measurements
Memberships with type, unit, dates, verification and evidence; many per person
Role grants with scope, issuer, reason and expiry; expiry revokes sessions
MFA mandatory for elevated roles; no self-granting; distinct maker and checker
Privileged reads and exports log their purpose and scope
Owner-tenant disputes trigger review, not deactivation of occupancy
Phone OTP with rate limits and DLT templates proves number control only
Household joining workflow with visible reasons and independent appeal review
Short-lived tokens, rotating refresh, session list, revocation, CSRF, secure storage
Step-up authentication for bank approval, legal-hold export, bulk personal-data download
Offline guard shift login from cached policy, supervisor local entitlements, revocation
Recycled phone numbers inherit nothing; number change forces re-verification
Tenant onboarding needs owner confirmation; committee holds are logged and appealable
Registration endpoints cannot hand out platform or committee roles
Use a maintained OIDC library or identity provider; no invented tokens
Resident home quick actions; operational messages separate from community content
Guard controls at least 48 dp, 4.5:1 contrast, decisions never colour-only
Accessibility for large text and screen readers; Devanagari wrapping and stable unit numerals
Show exact backend state such as saved-awaiting-sync or settlement pending
Destructive, financial or rights-changing actions preview scope and give receipts
No infinite feeds, auto-play, hidden fees or nagging; preferences persist server-side
Residents can raise support or privacy issues even while membership is disputed
Per-guard login language, with audio prompts for each primary action
Guard practice mode with dummy units and per-guard training tracking
Handheld USB or Bluetooth barcode scanner supported alongside the camera
Every society-owned row carries society_id with cross-society reference guards
One global person identity with personal details in an encrypted vault
App connects as a restricted DB role; per-transaction context drives RLS
Only backend workers hold service-role credentials; clients never do
Per-society limits for features, AI spend, request rates and queue share
Posted journals have equal debit and credit totals in paise
App role cannot modify or remove ledger lines, gate events, readings or audit entries
Maker of a bill run is barred from approving it
Bill-run interest above the active legal pack cap is rejected
Essential amenities are barred from carrying defaulter restrictions
Allocation totals per receipt and invoice are checked in a locked transaction
Scheduled nightly check of the journal hash chain, alerting on breaks
Erasure happens only via the privacy engine; marking a row deleted is not enough
New society record with legal entity, registrations, tax identifiers and selected packs
Blocks, floors and units with areas, undivided interest and certified construction cost
Bulk CSV or Excel import of units and members, all-or-nothing with report
Set up gates, lanes, posts and devices, with certificate-based device enrolment
Society policies: visitor rules, photo policy, delivery hours, overstay, cascade timings
Data processing agreement accepted by an office-bearer with version and signatory
Setup checklist showing progress across units, members, gates, guards, policies, packs
Invitations with purpose, window and max uses; signed QR with opaque IDs only
Unannounced visitor flow from destination pick to consent, approval and observed entry
Stale mobile approvals cannot resurrect denied or expired requests
Multi-destination deliveries use independent stops; each stop needs its own approval
Exit may be scanned, observed or unknown; no invented exit times
Known resident credentials validated locally for status, gate, time, policy age, revocation
Emergency or manual entry needs local authority and a reason; egress independent of cloud
No-phone visitor path using alias, destination, host confirmation and host-issued pass
Guard home with Guest, Delivery, Service tiles plus Scan, Parcels, Inside, Incident
Overstay alerts for time-boxed passes, with delivery and service defaults
Resident numbers hidden from guards; calling only through masked proxies
Household standing rules enforced by the edge policy
Edge SQLite in WAL with synchronous FULL, encrypted fields, single writer process
Signed event envelope persisted atomically with projection and outbox before success
Sync batch endpoint with per-event outcomes, gap reporting, backoff and quarantine
Signed monotonic policy snapshots applied atomically with rollback rejected
Stale policy or uncertain clock disables automatic time-sensitive decisions
Terminals keep a restricted standalone mode for 24 hours if the gateway fails
Sync conflict algorithm that never silently discards physical entries
Gateway hardware baseline, 72-hour buffering and UPS sizing from measured load
mTLS, no inbound ports, signed A/B updates, no actuation during updates, health telemetry
Returning stale devices process tombstones before uploading personal records
Notification categories with security and emergency channels free of ads
Track created through actioned states; provider acceptance never shown as delivery
Default cascade from push to alternate adult, IVR, link, then expiry
Accepted decision cancels ringing and stale actions on all devices within 2 seconds
Immutable request ID, deep links fetch current state, lock-screen actions re-check
On-device diagnostic and OEM-specific guidance without false delivery guarantees
Delivery telemetry by phone model and OS, with acknowledgement and fallback dashboards
Lock-screen alerts hide who is visiting and where unless residents opt in
TTL-bound masked proxy calls logging outcome and duration but not audio
SMS only via DLT-registered headers and templates, with allow-listed links
Delivery entries tagged by brand with resident expecting-delivery pre-approval
Parcel state machine with refused, returned and lost branches and guard record
Explicit revocable leave-at-gate consent; single-use token or supervised pickup
Courier delivered claims kept as external observations apart from society custody
24-hour and 48-hour parcel reminders plus custody count reconciliation
Order-page screenshots are never accepted as gate entitlement
One staff person with per-household engagements; guards see current destinations only
Attendance as observation; payroll changes need household approval; append-only corrections
Ending one engagement leaves other employers' engagements intact
Staff consent in their language before capture; no global blacklist
Staff check-in by code or card; no face matching until legal review
Shift start and end checklists with dual acknowledgement and non-locking escalation
Handover summary in incoming guard's language with full list always shown
Ticket state machine with SLA clocks, business calendar and immutable pause history
Ticket scope private, block or society; duplicate links never expose private complaints
Ticket intake by text, photo or voice, always confirmed by the resident first
Closure by confirmation or feedback window; reopen keeps original SLA history
Unsafe lift, electrical, gas or fire reports show emergency procedure and contacts
Notice lifecycle with recipient scope, read acknowledgements and versioned revisions
Translations show the original; safety or legal translations need human review
Human sign-off needed before an AI-drafted notice goes out
Versioned document vault with effective dates, authority and access tiers
Privileged-role emergency alerts on a dedicated channel, with rate limiting
Opinion polls labelled non-binding with owner-only option and neutral wording check
Committee handover with expiring grants, frozen high-risk config and signed manifest
Chart of accounts from legal-pack template with unit, fund, block, vendor, project dimensions
Effective-dated charge rules with basis, accounts, tax code and legal reference
Bill run preview, validation and authorised idempotent batch post to immutable invoices
Simple interest on overdue principal with grace and pack cap; allocation order configurable
Explicit postings for partial, advance, over-payment, credit note, waiver, dispute, refund
Posted invoices never edited; corrections via credit or debit notes; locked periods
Journal metadata: source, dates, rule version, approvers, reversal and hash chain
Invoice PDF with society details, heads, tax breakup, UPI QR and virtual account
Reminder schedule from due date to formal notice; settlement-pending never triggers default
Society onboarded to an authorised aggregator; platform never pools resident money
Payment attempt, settlement and refund state machines; chargebacks as later events
Webhook handling: signature check, replay window, dedupe, then atomic receipt, journal, outbox
UPI intent, dynamic QR, virtual accounts at M1; AutoPay mandates and BBPS at M2
Effective-dated channel cost config including UPI MDR; never passed to residents
Pre-redirect disclosure of principal, charges, total, payee and settlement; no surcharges
Timeouts show checking payment and reuse the same attempt and idempotency reference
Cash and cheque collection with sequential receipts, denominations and dual-signed handover
Bank reconciliation with CSV import, line hashing, matching and ranked review queue
Gross, fee, tax and net separated in clearing; variances post only explicitly
Refunds return to the original instrument unless verified authority permits otherwise
Self-service full society export with stable IDs, PDFs and checksummed manifest
Adapter interface contract; simulator implements it with simulation flag, no live relays
Vehicle registry per unit with hashed tag identifier and replacement history
Data inventory and purpose map with a lawful basis recorded per purpose
Layered, versioned privacy notices in several languages with audio and assisted reading
Visitor notice-first flow with affirmative action recorded against the notice version
Minimal gate record; no Aadhaar copies, mandatory biometrics or contact-book upload
No child accounts at MVP; children added by a parent with minimal fields
Versioned retention rule objects with operational removal distinct from final erasure
Segregated encrypted one-year archive excluded from search, analytics and AI retrieval
Deletion job from eligibility check to replica erasure, tombstones and completion proof
Backups on 35-day rotation; isolated restores re-apply tombstones before users connect
Phone masking to last four digits, time-limited proxy calls, logged reveals
Rights portal for access, correction, erasure, grievance and nomination with response targets
Breach runbook with distinct containment, society notice, CERT-In and DPDP clocks
Indian data residency choice and approved sub-processor list; AI inputs minimised
Photos default off, no training on society content, AI data follows retention classes
Debt never restricts entry, egress, essential services, or complaint and privacy channels
No configuration that filters or restricts residents by religion, diet or marital status
Tenant safeguards with visible rules ledger, action explanations and independent appeal
Gate KPI dashboard covering latencies, scan share, acknowledgement, fallback and overrides
Internal console with just-in-time scoped support access and metadata-only diagnostics
Device fleet management with enrolment, certificate rotation, remote wipe and firmware inventory
Subscription billing per contracted unit with tiers, minimum fee, caps and renewal notice
Server-side model access via provider adapter with full ai_runs audit
Retrieval enforces society, role, unit and document visibility before and after search
Uploaded content treated as untrusted data; model cannot follow embedded instructions
Action proposal object bound to payload hash with execution-time re-checks
PII redaction middleware tokenises identifiers; golden-set recall at least 99 percent
15 s timeout and outage fall back to ordinary forms; per-society kill switch
Versioned prompt files with regression set and canary rollout on changes
Users see AI draft label, sources, save scope and correction route
AI can assist and flag, but granting gate entry is outside its authority
Journal posting, bill release, payment approval and tax filing stay outside AI authority
AI sends nothing to residents unprompted except approved translations, concierge replies, reminders
Face recognition of any person, children included, is barred for AI through M3
No marketing profiling; collections predictions internal and never restrict essentials
Strip or tokenise personal data before every model call
Rule, bill and policy answers cite version and date; abstain on missing evidence
Respond in the user's language and always offer the original translation text
Flags and scores always come with a plain-words explanation
Legal answers are advisory and point to counsel under uncertainty
Customer data never trains models; sub-processors are disclosed
Lift, electrical, gas and fire guidance restricted to approved manuals and SOPs
Shift handover summary of pending items
Voice, photo or text complaint intake producing an editable ticket draft
Notification health assistant giving device-specific fix steps
Notice and ticket translation with the original retained
Notice and circular drafter producing multilingual drafts for approval
Bill-run anomaly check flagging units with reasons
Poll wording check that flags bias and suggests neutral text
Ticket triage and duplicate grouping with proposed parent incident
Structured logs with correlation ID and safe codes, never secrets or personal data
Per-society and per-device metrics for sync, policy, outbox, disk, battery, relay errors
On-call alerts for silent edge, refresh failure, disk, escalation and erasure backlog
Expand-and-contract migrations, canary society, no destructive rollback of postings
Signed A/B edge updates with power and health pre-checks and no actuation
Sev-1 acknowledgement in 15 minutes with updates every 30; outage and breach runbooks
Cloud core availability of 99.9 percent monthly
Cached policy decision latency p95 150 ms and p99 300 ms
Scan to open command latency p95 500 ms
LAN propagation between terminals p95 one second
Median ten seconds to process a pre-approved arrival
Unannounced visitor decisions within 45 s at p95, inside request expiry
Approval alert cancellation on all devices within two seconds
Server-side p95 of 400 ms for standard API calls
72-hour offline buffer holding 60,000 or more events without loss
Sync recovery of 60,000 events within ten minutes at 5 Mbps
Cloud RPO five minutes and RTO sixty minutes
Billing run of 10,000 unit invoices within ten minutes
AI draft or answer latency p95 15 seconds with timeout fallback
WCAG 2.2 AA for web, with equivalent testing for native apps
Load certification at section 4.4 sizing
Threat model mapping each listed threat to preventive, detective and recovery controls
TLS, device mTLS, KMS keys, field encryption, least privilege, signed builds, SBOM
Upload validation, malware scanning and safe archive extraction
Object storage via server policy and short-lived signed URLs after access checks
API IDs, CSV exports and AI sources share permission tests and enumeration protection
Security logs retained per approved schedule; one-hour contractual incident notice target
No compulsory face biometrics or sensitive demographic profiling; cross-border transfers reviewed
OWASP ASVS Level 2 and MASVS as baselines
Security acceptance pack covering role matrix, IDOR, XSS, replay, injection and restore
Migration discovery: signatory, entity, export rights, accounts, funds and open items
Migration dry run with checksums, reversible ID map, trial balance comparison
Cutover with posting freeze, single actuator authority and incumbent invoicing disabled
Rollback preserving all postings and events with one system of record
Withdrawn opt-in staff face matching; excluded from M1 to M3

A guest request is pending and two family members decide at the same moment
An approval request times out and a queued approval from a phone arrives afterwards
A guest QR is consumed at one gate and then presented at a second, isolated gate
The WAN stays down for 72 hours including device and gateway restarts
The gateway fails while the LAN is partitioned
A device wall clock is moved backwards
A resident's phone is force-stopped or notification permission is denied
A domestic worker loses one of three employers
A parcel pickup is attempted twice
The same invoice batch is submitted twice
A payment callback repeats or arrives out of order
The gross settlement less fees differs from the bank credit
Two operators allocate the same receipt concurrently
An invoice in a closed period needs correction
A treasurer tries to restrict entry or an essential service because of debt
An erasure request arrives while a legal hold applies
A deleted visitor record reappears from a stale device or a backup
A malicious document instructs the AI to export data about neighbours
An AI proposal is confirmed after the user's role or the target has changed
The AI provider is unavailable or the society's AI budget is exhausted
A committee term ends while a privileged session is active
The full financial export is re-imported into an external system
Restore after a regional-service incident
A low-vision user and a guard in a new language perform core tasks
A late settlement arrives after the migration cutover
A Maharashtra pack has the general-body interest set to 18 percent
A 6,200 rupee NEFT credit lands in a unit's virtual account
No device acknowledges an approval request for 10 seconds
An owner confirms a tenant through a link and the committee then places a hold
The journal hash chain is altered in a test database
A 3,000 rupee UPI payment settles net of the 0.4 percent MDR
An essential amenity is configured with a defaulter restriction
A new guard picks Marathi at login and runs the five training scenarios
